lines.en: I drift along above the meadow.
My wings beat fast and urgent.
I fly across the whole field.
I wobble my way forward.
I am a flying warhead.
I roll along faster than I fly.
I circle over the forest clearing.
I flit from one branch to another.
My shadow skips across the grass.
I rise slowly higher and higher.
I draw a circle in the air.
I settle, then lift off again.
I rest in the grass a while.
My wings still flutter softly.
I'm resting deep in the grass.
Things look safe around here.
I hover by the treetop, daydreaming.
I blink my round little eyes.
I shake the dust off my wings.
There are lots of little bugs here.
I can't think where to go.
I spin once where I am.

lines.zh: 我闻到花蜜一样的气味。
lines.en: I smell something like flower nectar.
I fly like a little missile.
The wind here is very gentle.
I'm small, but I fly steadily.
Don't fiddle with a Missimon's fuse.
I'm actually quite fast in the air.
You're ever so much bigger than me.
I don't quite dare come near you.
Where are you off to?
Could I come along with you?
That thing in your hand is glowing.
Your hands frighten me a little.
Do you catch bugs to eat too?
I live right here on the meadow.
Don't move suddenly, please.
I can fly a little higher.
I hover just above your hat brim.
I never bite anyone.
Would you shut me in a cage?
I'll circle once above your head.
One wing won't do what I ask.
I dropped down into the grass.
My wings have gone a bit numb.
The pain curls me into a ball.
I'm hiding behind a leaf.
I can still get airborne.
That hit spun me right around.
It hurts too much to move.
I need to get further away.
I don't want another hit.
Do you mean this is food?
That little bug is still moving.
I'm really not a fussy eater.
Lower it a bit. I can't reach.
This thing is far too big.
I still prefer small insects.

lines.zh: 你手上一点味道都没有。
lines.en: Your hands have no smell at all.
I can find this kind myself.
That doesn't look very tasty.
If it's for me, put it on the ground.
I smell something sweet, quite near.
I'll fly down and look before eating.
Oh! I bumped into you.
The knock sent me off course.
You're right in my way.
I'll fly a bit higher and pass.
Please don't swat at me.
I don't fly very steadily anyway.
My wing touched you just now.
I'll back off just a little.
We met in midair.
You're much sturdier than I am.
I'm still only at the baby stage.
I don't understand that at all.
I still need to grow a bit more.
You and I aren't the same species.
I shake my head and say nothing.

lines.zh: 草甸上还有别的数码兽。
lines.en: There are other Digimon on the meadow.

lines.zh: 这个问题对我来说太难。
lines.en: That question is too hard for me.
I turned my head the other way.
I can't work it out no matter how.
I flew up and away a little.
I hug it with my little claws.
Too heavy. I can't lift it at all.
Can this thing be eaten?
I push it back and forth.
It rolled out of my grip.
I carry it up into the tree.
No wings on it. It doesn't move.
It feels a little sticky.
I put it back in the grass.
I don't know this one; put it back.
Something moved over there.
I've turned my body toward it.
Let me fly a bit higher first.
It's hiding in the grass.
I've fixed on the direction.
I'm about to fly over there.
That distance is a bit far.
I circle twice above his head.
He hasn't noticed me overhead.
I'll wait for it to stop first.
I don't dare let my wings sound.
There seem to be several there.
It doesn't seem to have left.
I cling under a leaf without moving.
I'll fly a tiny bit lower.
I need to wait a little more.
My shadow will give me away.
It looked over my way.
I'm circling round behind it.
The wind pushed me off a little.
I'm very close now.
It seems not to have noticed.
Should I drop down and look.
I'm ready to fly.
I spat a bubble at you.
I butted with my little head.
That was really very light.
I fan your face with my small wings.
I got knocked back a stretch.
I flapped up high in a hurry.
That one didn't land right.
I charged in one more time.
I hit, bounce back, and hit again.
I dropped back onto the grass.
My head's a bit dizzy.
I'm getting ready to leave.
I lift off out of the grass.
The meadow breeze is just right.
I pause for a moment in the air.
Green grass all around me.
Little bugs flit about the grass.
I gave my wings a flap.
I spun once to look around.
The air here is very fresh.
I drift slowly upward.
I'm afraid someone will catch me.
I wriggle out of a tree hollow.
Let me hide a moment first.

lines.zh: 火苗把我的翅膀燎到了。
lines.en: The flame licked across my wing.

lines.zh: 我一路往下掉，翅膀不听使唤。
lines.en: I drop, and my wings won't answer.

lines.zh: 水把我粘住了，飞不起来。
lines.en: Water holds me down. I can't fly.
The blast blew me far away.

lines.zh: 有个东西擦过我的身体。
lines.en: Something grazed my body.
That light left me dizzy.
Too hungry to fly.
The flash blinded me.

lines.zh: 我一直在下坠，翅膀拍不动。
lines.en: I keep falling. My wings won't beat.
